summary: Both buys are small (2.5% and 1.7% of equity) and break no cap, but they add about $2.20 to the 10% market-drop loss (21.92 to 24.12, 3.6% to 4.0% of equity) and take cash from 14.7% to 10.5%. MSM is described as a new sector, yet FAST (already held at 5.0%) is a direct industrial-distribution peer, so the portfolio gets more exposed to one MRO theme rather than diversified. Neither lesson in learning.json (L1, L2) names the Implicator, so none was applied.

The two together would be about $45, 7.5%. Beta 0.72 and low-ish vol add no new market-direction diversifier. No meaningful overlap with VOO/VTI beyond their tiny index weight.
